body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Edifier announced its ‘Rainbow Wireless Speaker System’ during CES 2008.

By using an ultra low loss, and no compression infrared technology, Edifier has designed this unique product as a wireless solution for the perfect home audio experience. The system includes an infrared transmitter, an infrared receiver, a high power class D amplifier, all Aluminum enclosures, and an optional pair of speakers.
